provenance: Original geometric SVG artwork created for Neill Data Suite, October 2026. No third-party artwork or icon-font dependency.

icons.label: Suite hub
icons.recommendation: Candidate for hub favicon and suite launcher; four destinations share one home.

icons.label: Planner
icons.recommendation: Candidate for planner/favicon.svg and Planner PWA icons; floor-plan walls remain distinct at 16 px.

icons.label: Upload
icons.recommendation: Candidate for upload/favicon.svg and Upload PWA icons; an upward arrow lands above a file tray.

icons.label: Search
icons.recommendation: Candidate for search/favicon.svg and Search PWA icons; a large magnifier reads clearly in a browser tab.

icons.label: Quote
icons.recommendation: Candidate for quote/favicon.svg; a price tag identifies quoting without tiny currency text.

icons.label: Timesheet
icons.recommendation: Candidate for Timesheet browser, Apple touch and PWA icons; preserve the existing green app colour.

icons.label: Switchboard
icons.recommendation: Candidate for swb/favicon.svg and SWB PWA icons; an enclosed bolt identifies the switchboard tool.

icons.label: Fit-off
icons.recommendation: Candidate for fitoff/favicon.svg; a bold completion mark distinguishes it from the green Timesheet clock.

icons.label: Install checklist
icons.recommendation: Candidate for the Checklist browser icon; paired checks distinguish the list from the Fit-off completion mark.

icons.label: Assets library
icons.recommendation: Candidate for the Assets showroom favicon; stacked layers represent reusable building blocks.

icons.label: Company
icons.recommendation: Candidate for company/favicon.svg; a team glyph represents membership and workspace access.

icons.label: Website
icons.recommendation: Candidate for the public website favicon; keep rollout separate from internal tools if the public brand changes.

icons.label: Mark up photo
icons.recommendation: Use inline at 20–24 px; inherits the surrounding text colour. Pass title:'' beside a visible label.
